{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, confirm the format
print("Revenue format examples:", data['revenue'].head().tolist())

data['revenue_parsed'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any QA orders (999999.99) exist
qa_orders = (data['revenue_parsed'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", qa_orders)

# Drop any QA orders
if qa_orders > 0:
    data_clean = data[data['revenue_parsed'] != 999999.99]
else:
    data_clean = data

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# Since they don't represent actual revenue, and the question is about campaign success
# which should reflect completed transactions
completed_data = data_clean[data_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check cleaned data
print("Remaining rows after filtering:", len(completed_data))"}
